title: Scientology's surveillance file on Sheehan

tellings.quote: Well, they had they had, you know, pictures pictures of me.

plain: In the 1970s, the Church of Scientology, a religious movement founded by L. Ron Hubbard and based in Clearwater, Florida, kept a surveillance file on the lawyer Dan Sheehan, he says, with "pictures of me" in it. Sheehan tells this himself, saying he saw the file, and he mentions the lawyer Mark Lane in the same account. It would mean the church was watching him closely while he dealt with it.
